fields.description:
As an accounts receivable analyst I want to filter the invoice list by due date range so that I can quickly find overdue invoices and follow up with customers.

Acceptance criteria:
* The invoice list has a "Due date from" and "Due date to" filter.
* Only invoices whose due date is within the range (inclusive) are shown.
* If "from" is later than "to", an error message "Invalid date range" is displayed and the list is not filtered.
* Clearing both fields shows all invoices again.
